name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2017 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK for ICS techniques for the 2017 Triton safety system attack (campaign C0030 and software S1009, with Mandiant's December 2017 report and ICSA-18-107-02) and the ICS rows ATT&CK lists for WannaCry (S0366) and NotPetya (S0368). Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2017.md. Scores: 100 the source or the ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
